title: Abandoned Mineral Lands in the National Park System — A Pictorial Summary
authors: NPS Mining and Minerals Branch, Land Resources Division
summary: The National Park Service's 1990 pictorial summary of abandoned mineral lands: 1,936 sites and 9,934 abandoned mine hazards and openings in 120 park units by region, the safety hazards and resource damage they cause, their historical significance and wildlife habitat, and the eight steps of the NPS abandoned mineral lands program.
